items.title: Claude Code 2.1.311 released
items.text: Added --hold-idle-file and --max-hold-min to self-hosted-runner, to keep an idle session while your host reports processes it left running · Added a tip for the Explanatory output style, shown when you ask Claude for explanations · Fixed long freezes at startup and after reading or editing files when a CLAUDE.md file holds a very long list item · Fixed interrupting Claude not taking effect until a timeout while an MCP server had not answered a resource read or a skill was still downloading
